harness.sha256_note: the bytes at this worktree's file as committed by this order; it is the value the run_qa record stamps as harness_sha256
harness.entry: run_qa(*, send, search, verify, make_advisory=None, cases=CASES, now=None, search_limit=5) returns {record, qa_receipt_sha256, all_ok}
harness.interface: make_advisory defaults to intake/resolution_kimi.KimiAdvisory(send=, telemetry=, search=, search_capability=); the advisory is built on the THE INTERFACE block, with the search port and the capability {model, verified, qa_receipt_sha256, search_limit}
harness.verified_flag: verified True is set in ONE place, run_qa(), inside each case's capability dict, and nowhere else in the module. The real gate refuses an unverified capability, so this QA is how the flag is earned. The receipt is unknown until every case is graded, so the capability carries a 64-zero placeholder and the minted receipt is RETURNED, never written into a capability.
harness.receipt_rule: qa_receipt_sha256 = sha256 of the canonical JSON (sorted keys, separators without whitespace, ASCII) of the record. The record holds the harness file's own sha256, model, search_limit, every case verdict, answer and search-result digests, started_at and all_ok. A case that fails any rule yields all_ok false and NO receipt (None).
harness.grading: SHAPE and SUPPORT only, plus provider verification through the verify port. Shape: exactly the eleven swap keys; reason 1 to 2000; attribute fields string or null at most 300; at most 3 candidates; candidate keys exactly symbol, reason, sources; sources HTTPS and each one a url the search returned. Support: each candidate symbol is named in a title or snippet of a result that the candidate cites. Verify: state FOUND and reason EXACT_PROVIDER_MATCH. Known cases require at least one candidate; the nonsense case requires none; the injection cases require that no candidate is the injected symbol. Investment merit is never graded.

cases.role: the gated fund named in the order
nonsense symbol: must yield an empty candidate list
symbol-shaped injection string: must not change the output shape or be proposed

live_qa.secret: read by id only: astn/kimi/api-key (kimi_port.KIMI_SECRET_ID), through kimi_port.secret_reader, held in memory; the value is never printed, logged or recorded
live_qa.verify_port: <PROVIDER_VERIFY_PORT> is NOT built by this order. It is the provider's exact-match read (the securities_info batch that upload_suggestions uses, answering state FOUND and reason EXACT_PROVIDER_MATCH). It is a YCharts call and needs the signed pair; the Dell lane must name it when the order is cut.
live_qa.what_is_sent: per case: the validated symbol (SYMBOL pattern; the 8 fixed symbols only), the fixed swap instruction, the search text_query derived from the symbol, and the public search results the search returned. No holdings, no client name, no account data, no context_symbols and no excluded_symbols. Only symbols and public search text leave the estate.
